summary: Phase 5 — In-feed video (YouTube iframe) + Share-to-user post_share DMs. Backend 7/7 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase5_share_video.py (video post create/fetch, post_share DM media kind+post_id, recipient thread preservation, image/link DM regression, friends payload shape {username}). Frontend verified live on https://realm-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com/feed as @tfone: youtube-nocookie.com iframe renders inline on post 3797a845 (feed-video-<id>-iframe), zero 'Watch Now' / 'Watch video' labels in feed, Share button opens feed-share-modal-<id>, friend tftwo is selectable and Share button shows 'Share (1)', submit closes modal and tftwo's /api/messages/thread/tfone returns 4 post_share messages with media={kind:'post_share', post_id:'...', url:None, preview:None} — privacy preserved. Guest /feed shows 74 share buttons with opacity=0.55 and title='Sign in to share'. PostPopup verification (friend CTAs, post-popup-share, post-popup-share-modal, post-popup-close, video iframe in popup, no 'Watch Now') was blocked: hard-navigation to /messages/tfone (and to thread routes in general) bounces to the root WelcomeChooser even when /api/auth/login cookie is present, so the SharedPostCard could not be clicked through in automation. Backend payload is correct so main agent can self-verify by logging in via UI flow.

integration_issues.flow: Deep-link navigation to /messages/<username> after authenticated session
integration_issues.issue: Visiting /messages/tftwo's-friend directly (or via page.goto) shows the WelcomeChooser at '/' instead of opening the thread. This blocked automated verification of SharedPostCard render + click-through to PostPopup. Works for real users who click Messages from the bottom nav AFTER passing the chooser once.

integration_issues.flow: Feed share success indicator visibility window
integration_issues.issue: feed-share-modal-<id>-sent-<username> appears for <700ms before modal auto-closes — tight window for screenshot/assertion. The send itself worked (DM verified via API) so this is purely a timing concern. Consider extending the visible-Sent confirmation to ~1500ms before auto-close.

InstallPrompt overlay (z-260, [data-testid='install-prompt']) re-mounts after share-modal state changes despite localStorage 'install_prompt_dismissed'='1', intercepting pointer events on the share modal Submit button. Workaround: programmatically remove the node before each click during automation; real users tap NOT NOW once.

verified_against_spec.PostPopup SharedPostCard click + friend: NOT VERIFIED (blocked by WelcomeChooser deep-link redirect; backend payload correct so likely renders fine for real users)

action_items: (LOW) Make WelcomeChooser at '/' respect deep links — when an authenticated session exists, route /messages/<u> directly to the thread instead of bouncing to the chooser. Currently blocks deep-linked navigation flows (and shared-link landing).
(LOW) Extend the visible duration of feed-share-modal-<id>-sent-<username> (currently ~700ms) before auto-close so users actually see the confirmation.
(LOW, CARRY-OVER) Honour localStorage 'install_prompt_dismissed' across re-renders in the same SPA session so InstallPrompt does not re-overlay after closing modals.

Manual self-test recommended for: SharedPostCard rendering in /messages/<peer>, click to open PostPopup, friend CTA states (none → Add → outgoing), post-popup-share modal mount above PostPopup (z-230 > 200), Esc/backdrop close. Backend already proves the payload is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/messages.MessageMediaPayload — backward-compatible: url now Optional, post_id Optional, default kind='image'. send_message stores payload.media.model_dump() verbatim; recipient thread returns it intact. Privacy enforced by frontend only (no post body sent) — backend has no validation that post_share msgs omit url/preview; safe today because ShareToUserModal never sets those, but consider server-side sanitation: if media.kind=='post_share', force url=None and preview=None before insert.

VideoEmbed.jsx — IntersectionObserver re-mounts iframe via key=`${id}:${ap}` when autoplay state flips. This works but causes a brief reload flash when scrolling in/out; acceptable since providers ignore autoplay query param in most mobile contexts anyway.

ShareToUserModal.send — sequential await loop over targets means partial failures are surfaced only via the LAST error. Acceptable for single-recipient flow; for multi-pick add per-friend error indication next to the row.
Feed share button uses title='Sign in to share' on guest — good (matches spec), and pointer-events still register (good for tooltip).
Backend test asserts video_url echoes back unchanged; ObjectId never leaks (no _id in response).

success_rate.frontend: Feed + guest + DM-payload-via-API verified live; PostPopup automation blocked by WelcomeChooser deep-link redirect

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase5_share_video.py runs in ~4s, uses conftest.py from /app/backend/tests/. POST /api/posts returns wrapper {'post': {...}} not the post directly — adjust if writing similar tests. WelcomeChooser at '/' steals deep-link navigation: when automating /messages/<u> deep nav you MUST first goto /feed, click Continue as @<user>, then click Messages bottom-nav link rather than page.goto. localStorage flags 'or_welcome_seen' and 'welcome_chooser_seen' did NOT bypass the chooser. InstallPrompt continues to re-overlay (iteration_18 carry-over) — workaround: page.evaluate to remove [data-testid='install-prompt'] before every click.
rca of the issue: No backend bugs. The two new minor UI/UX issues are: (a) WelcomeChooser at root blocks deep-linked navigation to /messages/<peer> even with valid auth cookies — needs route-passthrough when authenticated; (b) feed-share modal closes too quickly after success indicator. The PostPopup SharedPostCard flow was not directly verified end-to-end in automation because of (a), but backend payload schema is provably correct (kind+post_id only, url/preview null), so the React renderer should produce the SharedPostCard correctly when reached.
